visual_text: An MMSE score is not a capacity assessment
Above 24: incapacity less likely, not ruled out (0.14)
MMSE bands only. Not for other tests.
alt_text: Diagram of an MMSE scale from 0 to 30 in three zones. Below 20: incapacity for a treatment decision is more likely (likelihood ratio 6.3). 20 to 24: no clear change (0.87). Above 24: incapacity less likely, but not ruled out (0.14). A bracket reads: Then assess the decision. Pooled studies of treatment decisions in medical patients; MMSE bands only.
